title: New game story
description: new_game_story.yaml: where the story stands when a new game gives the player control. Every trigger starts clear; the new-game section of MAPHEAD and the entry section of the script it loads may set some (dwx, formats::script::findNewGameTriggers).

map.description: Id of the first map (data/maps), or its number when no map has it.

script.description: The DG.SCN script MAPHEAD loads on it.

triggers_set.description: The triggers set when the player gets control, sorted.

agreed.description: False when the paths of a new game end with different triggers set: triggers_set holds the ones they share.

triggers_unknown.description: The triggers the game code may have set before the new-game section runs, which the walk does not model (the starting partner's raised trigger), sorted. They are neither set nor clear.
